entries.title: Introduction
entries.summary: isonim-docs is a Nim documentation-site framework built on IsoNim, with one component codebase driving SSG, SSR, and SPA rendering.

entries.title: Getting Started
entries.summary: Scaffold an isonim-docs consumer, author content with frontmatter, and build or serve the site.

entries.title: Routing
entries.summary: How isonim-docs resolves routes -- auto-discovery from content, or an explicit hand-authored manifest.

entries.title: Theming & Design Tokens
entries.summary: The --docs-* CSS custom-property contract and the token layer that binds each variable to a light + dark value.
headings: Wiring the layer into the build

entries.title: Extended Markdown
entries.summary: The isonim-docs Markdown engine -- code fences with syntax highlighting and a copy button, tabs, and six admonition severities.

entries.title: Navigation & Search
entries.summary: The recursive sidebar, breadcrumbs, and prev/next navigation, the in-browser client search index, and the optional server-side search path with pluggable backends.

entries.title: SEO & Error Handling
entries.summary: Build-time SEO artifacts (canonical/OpenGraph/Twitter/JSON-LD, sitemap.xml, robots.txt) and the resilient 404/500 fallback pages that always retain site chrome.

entries.title: OpenAPI REST Reference
entries.summary: Build-time OpenAPI v3 ingestion (YAML + JSON) into a typed model and a Stripe-style three-column reference page with method color-coding, synthesized code samples, and deep-linkable per-operation anchors.

entries.title: Library API Reference
entries.summary: Nim source/docstring ingestion into a symbol reference model, stable per-symbol anchors, and the [[sym:...]] cross-reference syntax resolved by the reference checker.

entries.title: Live Component Embedding
entries.summary: Extracting custom component tags from markdown into bkComponent AST nodes, binding them by name to a consumer registry, per-embed isolated state, and the error boundary.
headings: Per-embed isolated state and the error boundary

entries.title: Tutorials, Versioning & i18n
entries.summary: The interactive tutorial layout with step progress and completion tracking, documentation versioning with /vX.Y/ route prefixes, and i18n with locale prefixes, a translation table, and hreflang alternates.

entries.title: Plugins
entries.summary: The deterministic plugin host with onConfig / preParse / postParse / onRender / onBuildComplete lifecycle hooks and custom markdown-directive registration.

entries.title: Dev Server & Live Reload
entries.summary: The development server built on the SSR render path, its content-tree file watcher, the websocket live-reload channel, and the full-page error overlay.

entries.title: CLI Toolchain
entries.summary: The isonim-docs command-line binary with init / dev / build / serve subcommands, colored output, and layered flag / .env configuration overrides.

entries.title: Deployment (nginx Adapter)
entries.summary: The --target=nginx build producing an nginx-link-function SSR module, and the content-agnostic adapter that wires the framework's renderer to the C-ABI.

entries.title: CSP & Analytics
entries.summary: Build-time Content-Security-Policy generation with per-page inline-script SHA-256 hashing, and a vendor-neutral, DNT-honoring analytics adapter emitted only when configured.

entries.title: Feature Index
entries.summary: A capabilities matrix of every isonim-docs framework feature, each linked to its documentation page, with its shipped status.
